test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following awards is given to Gram Panchayats/Gram Parishads for their outstanding contribution to socio-economic development by involving village councils?

options.text: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Panchayat Empowerment Award (DDUPSP)
Nanaji Deshmukh National Gaurav Gram Sabha Award (NDRGGSP)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Nanaji Deshmukh National Gaurav Gram Sabha Award (NDRGGSP)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Nanaji Deshmukh National Gaurav Gram Sabha Award (NDRGGSP) is given to Gram Panchayats/Gram Parishads for their outstanding contribution to socio-economic development.
 
• This award recognizes the effective functioning of Gram Sabhas, which are village councils in India.
 
• It promotes the involvement of village councils in the decision-making process, ensuring community participation in governance.
 
• Named after Nanaji Deshmukh, a social activist and a Padma Vibhushan awardee, this award encourages grassroots democracy and decentralized planning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gram Panchayat Development Plan Award (GPDPA)**

 
 
• This award is given for the effective preparation and implementation of Gram Panchayat Development Plans.
 
• It aims to incentivize panchayats to focus on comprehensive and inclusive planning for local development.
 
 
 
• **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Panchayat Empowerment Award (DDUPSP)**
 
 
• This award is given to panchayats for their outstanding work in improving governance and delivering services.
 
• It emphasizes capacity building and empowerment of panchayats.
 
 
 
• **Child Friendly Gram Panchayat Award (CFGPA)**
 
 
• This award is given to Gram Panchayats that have made significant contributions to child welfare and development.
 
• It focuses on creating an environment conducive to the overall development of children in the village.
